recommendation.status: Rounded planning proxy; not an observed national NITS average
recommendation.label: National transmission cost / peak-demand proxy

national_proxy.table: AEO2026 Counterfactual Baseline Table54, United States
national_proxy.formula: transmission cents/kWh * sales TWh * 1e7 / (national peak GW * 1000) * dollar deflator
national_proxy.weighting: Ratio of national transmission-service expenditure proxy to summed utility planning peaks; equivalent to peak weighting if regional costs and peaks are aligned. Not an arithmetic utility average. National numerator and denominator drawn from different sources; both modeled/forecast, not audited tariff receipts.
limitations: Annual summer planning peaks are not 12CP/1CP tariff billing determinants.
EIA service category cost differs in scope from individual NITS schedules and is modeled rather than observed tariff collection.
AEO is national including implicit Alaska/Hawaii quantities; FERC planning-area aggregation primarily contiguous US. Small coverage mismatch remains.
National total-demand weighting does not identify future data-center geographic weights.
No national observed tariff-billing-demand-weighted NITS average was established in this bounded review.
national_proxy.status: AEO modeled expenditure divided by FERC714-based aggregated utility forecast peak. This is a national cost-intensity proxy, not tariff survey or measured billing-demand-weighted rate.

incorrect_conversion_warning.meaning: Valid bill equivalent only if charging a DC the national average volumetric transmission price; not a measured demand-based NITS tariff. Do not use DC load factor to infer system billing-demand denominator.

miso_cross_check.note: MISO published systemwide point-to-point rate, not exact network-zone weighted tariff; incorporates adjustments including flowgate factor. Schedule9 generally shares zone base rates but special subzone treatment matters.
miso_cross_check.MVP_note: Schedule26A additional volumetric charge, regional applicability and billing energy must be applied before adding to any individual network customer. Do not call base Schedule9 full transmission bill.

methodology_source.note: Average revenues equal revenue requirements / kWh sales; transmission remains cost of service and includes return on rate base, fixed O&M, annual depreciation.
